newsitem.title: USA: Motorola wins $65 mln China cellular deal.
newsitem.headline: Motorola wins $65 mln China cellular deal.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Cellular Infrastructure Group said Monday it won a $65 million contract with China Unicom for a major expansion and upgrade of its mobile cellular system in China's Guangdong province.

The contract is for its digital Global system for Mobile Communications (GSM) network. The network currently covers two cities, and after the upgrade will include the entire province, including 10 additional cities, Motorola said.

As part of the contract, Motorola will install its M-Cell 6 base stations. Shipment of the equipment is expected to begin this month with commercial service in all cities planned by the end of the year.
Motorola provides wireless communications, semiconductors and advanced electronic systems, components and services.
